metadata.title: beads import --dry-run silently ignored (still writes)
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed via readBoolOption. Verified --dry-run writes nothing (before=0 after=0).

issues/pm-beads-nfpq.toon.body:
Bug class #1 (option-key normalization). Runtime normalizes --dry-run to dryRun; handler read ctx.options["dry-run"] (always undefined).
Repro: pm beads import items.jsonl --dry-run
Observed: actually imported 3 items (before=0 after=3), printed "Imported 3". Exit 0.
Expected: write nothing, print [dry-run] previews.
Fix: added readBoolOption(options,"dry-run","dryRun"). Verified before=0 after=0, prints dry-run previews.

metadata.title: beads import returns error object instead of throwing (exit 0 on failure + malformed file)
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: throw on no-arg/read-failure + throw when all lines failed. Verified exit 1 for missing-file/no-arg/fully-malformed; partial stays exit 0.

issues/pm-beads-w7ru.toon.body:
Bug class #4 (wrong exit code). Failure paths returned { error } -> host exit 0; also a fully-malformed JSONL imported 0 yet exited 0.
Repro (before fix):
  pm beads import /tmp/nope.jsonl ; echo $? -> 0
  pm beads import ; echo $?              -> 0
  pm beads import bad.jsonl ; echo $?    -> 0 (every line unparseable)
Expected: non-zero.
Fix: throw on no-arg and read failure; throw when imported===0 && skipped>0 (whole file failed). Partial imports stay lenient (exit 0).
Verified: missing-file/no-arg/fully-malformed all exit 1; 1-good-1-bad exits 0.

features/pm-beads-dt52.toon.body: Functional test pass running pm beads import against a real workspace with a crafted Beads JSONL file. Verifying exit codes and that --dry-run takes effect. Hunting the 4 known bug classes.

metadata.title: Add publish retry + provenance fallback to release workflow
metadata.description: Replace the npm publish step in .github/workflows/release.yml with a resilient version that (1) skips if the version is already published, (2) retries up to 3 times with 30s sleep, and (3) falls back to publishing without --provenance after persistent registry 404s. Permanent fix for the 2026-05-27 npm E404 outage that left all 19 packages tagged in git but unpublished on npm.
metadata.author: codex

tasks/pm-beads-urtk.toon.body: Implemented release-ready package metadata and automation for pm-beads using the latest pm CLI 2026.5.24 and pm SDK contracts. Added local pm project tracking, CI/release workflows, pm-changelog integration, TypeScript checks, production audit gates, dry-run packaging, installability metadata, and registry metadata.
